name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Charbroiled New York Strip Steak & Idaho Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
whyItWorks: Lean hand-cut New York strip steak charbroiled with sea salt and cracked pepper. Rich in bioavailable iron and zinc, paired with fluffy Idaho potato flesh.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the New York Strip medium with a plain baked Idaho potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip tough potato skins).
watchOuts: Chew steak thoroughly and discard tough outer potato skin
